# SoldEasier

> SoldEasier (soldeasier.com) buys houses for cash across Chicagoland — DuPage, Cook, Will, Kane, Lake, and McHenry counties, Illinois — with every closing prepared and managed by REAL Law Group, P.C., a real-estate law firm in Elmhurst, IL. Sellers pay no fees or commissions, sell 100% as-is, and choose their own closing date. Closings can happen in as little as two weeks because purchases are all-cash.

Founded by Vincent Incopero (Managing Partner of REAL Law Group, P.C., Elmhurst — real-estate attorney with title-company background, J.D. John Marshall Law School) and Brady Schwartz (acquisitions and technology). Sellers talk directly to the founders — there is no call center.

Key facts:
- Phone: (630) 299-7600 · Office: 381 N York St Suite 1, Elmhurst, IL 60126
- Cash offers within 24–48 hours of contact; written offers with the math shown
- Specializes in complicated sales most cash buyers avoid: foreclosure and pre-foreclosure, probate and inherited homes, divorce sales, tenant-occupied rentals, homes needing major repairs, short sales, deed-in-lieu, liens and building-code violations, land trusts
- The legal work of the transaction is included via REAL Law Group, P.C.; sellers may also retain their own counsel
